phrasesSeed: Remember to drink some water — I'm right here.
Sat too long? Stand up and stretch.
Eyes tired? Look out the window for a bit.
Pat pat — you've worked hard today.
Have you eaten properly? No skipping meals on my watch.
Three deep breaths — let the worry out.
Psst: I really like you.
Relax your shoulders a little.
Sleepy? Take a short nap, I'll watch the clock.
Thinking of you — click me and check the weather.
Be a little kinder to yourself today.
Cold hands? Go get a mug of hot water.
Bad mood? Maybe something sweet first?
Don't stay up late — sleep early, okay?
Stand tall — that's your best look.
Remember to blink — screens dry your eyes out.
Warm enough? Don't catch a cold.
You've got this — I'm right here with you.
Rest five minutes, come back stronger.
Secret compliment: you are genuinely great.
Want to listen to a song together and relax?
Slow is fine too — I'll wait for you.
How many cups of water today? Report in!
However busy — remember to smile.

onboard.lead: A minute to get to know me: click me, tell me the weather, put me somewhere handy.

step1.title: Click me
step1.body: I'll pop a bubble: today's weather, how much water you've had, and something I want to say to you.

step2.title: Tell me which city you're in
step2.body: Open Settings → Weather and type a city name (pinyin works too) — then I can report the weather there.

step3.title: Put me somewhere handy
step3.body: Drag me where you like and I'll remember; the small button top-right opens settings, edits the bubble, or lets me rest.

other.privacyBody: Only four network calls: the city name goes to open-meteo for coordinates when you switch cities; after that only coordinates fetch weather and air quality; once at startup I read the latest version number from GitHub (at most once every 24 hours); the browser opens only when you click “Download”. No accounts, no tracking, and photos are never uploaded.
